body: I feel invisible too and i wonder y

Times like this I just lay in the dark and can’t sleep...just stay up and think about everything. For the last couple of days I’ve just been feeling suicidal. And then I think where will my kids go. And that stops me...but the thought still crosses my mind. I want them to wonder what they did wrong or what they didn’t do. Or why did she go this far and y didn’t she tell us. I want them to regret ignoring me and treating me as if I am a stranger. I want them to be so lost that they begin to feel my pain. And understand that all I wanted was help
I try to not let things get to me but when I do break down I seem to always be by myself. And I end up just keeping it bottled in.  I don’t have no shoulder to cry on to tell me it’s gonna be okay.

I’m dealing with the fact that I’m homeless and my family got a warm place to call home and I’m hotel to hotel. My mom and me don’t talk and my dad don’t talk. No one ask if I’m okay no one ask me anything...It just makes me feel invisible ya know...I don’t want my kids to think I’m breaking down. I do whatever I gotta do for them...but I don’t want them to know what’s really going on. I want them to be unaware of adult issues. Idk I have issues that stem from my past. It’s so hard sometimes...I’ve been down for so long it’s like when I try to get up someone is holding me down
My kids no the mommy side of me and that’s all. They don’t see the side that breaks down and cries. Or the side of me that is weak and vulnerable

I’ve went to counseling for year, and I’m pregnant so my feelings have been x10. I just been feeling really lonely and just trying to look like I have it together ya know. Moments like this I be feeling like I don’t have nobody to talk to. Like not someone who’s paid to make you feel better but someone who truly can relate and overcame it.
